<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$truth = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): true {
        if ($incoming === "bad") {
            echo "TRUE;";
            return false;
        }
        $incoming = false;
        return true;
    }
};
$falsehood = new class {
    public function __get(string|int $incoming): false {
        if ($incoming === "bad") {
            echo "FALSE;";
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};
$nothing = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): null {
        if ($incoming === "bad") {
            echo "NULL;";
            return 0;
        }
        return null;
    }
};
$selector = "value";
echo $truth->$selector === true ? "T;" : "BAD_T;";
echo $falsehood->value === false ? "F;" : "BAD_F;";
echo $nothing->value === null ? "N;" : "BAD_N;";
echo $truth->echo;
echo ";";
$nothing->drop;
echo "D;";
$destination = 42;
try {
    $destination = $truth->bad === true;
} catch (TypeError $firstFailure) {
    echo $firstFailure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP_T;" : "BAD_STORE_T;";
try {
    $destination = $falsehood->bad === false;
} catch (TypeError $secondFailure) {
    echo $secondFailure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP_F;" : "BAD_STORE_F;";
try {
    $destination = $nothing->bad === null;
} catch (TypeError $thirdFailure) {
    echo $thirdFailure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP_N;" : "BAD_STORE_N;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";
